request: Goal: Implement Issue #385 by making artifact producers close mechanical validation immediately after artifact creation or mutation. Scope: In src/flow/run-gate.js, registry.js, and related artifact validation modules mentioned by the Issue, extract or organize common producer-side completion helpers for normalize, validate, deterministic repair once, and revalidate. Apply the helper path to draft.json and spec.json producer/repair completion, scenario-validity-result.json, test-execute-result.json v2, test-result-review artifacts, and implementation completion state for req/file-map/lint readiness. Update review/gate retry handling so mechanical, protocol, tooling, and AI output schema failures do not consume semantic reviewRetry or gateRetry, while AI semantic FAIL does. When semantic retry is exhausted in draft-gate, spec-review, spec-gate, impl-review, or impl-gate, write unresolved findings to flow-findings.json and keep them in later flow context for acceptance-review. Acceptance: existing tests plus new regression tests show clean artifacts are available before draft/spec guardrail calls, invalid producer artifacts fail as mechanical/protocol failures, semantic FAIL still consumes retry, and exhausted semantic findings no longer stop at review/gate. Out of Scope: New top-level flow phase, new generic FlowNode preHooks/postHooks attributes, and inheritance-based step hierarchy.
